arguments.content:
import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    print('FILES IN ARCHIVE:')
    for n in z.namelist():
        print(' ', n)
    sheet_xml = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml')

root = ET.fromstring(sheet_xml)
sheet_data = root.find('m:sheetData', NS)
print('\nCELLS (row, col_ref, value):')
for row in sheet_data.findall('m:row', NS):
    for c in row.findall('m:c', NS):
        ref = c.get('r')
        t = c.get('t')
        v = c.find('m:v', NS)
        isv = c.find('m:is', NS)
        if v is not None:
            val = v.text
        elif isv is not None:
            val = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in isv.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
        else:
            val = None
        print(f'  {ref} (type={t}): {val!r}')
